title: IEEE Ada Lovelace Day 2026
summary: A free UWI St Augustine engineering event with talks on data science, AI and cybersecurity, a panel Q&A and networking.
description: IEEE Women in Engineering Trinidad & Tobago is hosting an in-person Ada Lovelace Day programme at UWI St Augustine on Saturday 10 October 2026. The programme includes guest speakers from BOETT and the fields of data science, artificial intelligence and cybersecurity, followed by a moderated panel Q&A and networking. IEEE vTools lists no admission charge and registration is open.
